cases.name: first request uses the full-wire bound
exact retained prefix reuses measured input and reserves prior output
replacement controls add their complete serialized byte bound
removed controls never subtract previously observed input
changed or removed retained inputs fall back instead of reusing a stale anchor
another model cannot inherit measured context
UTF-8 suffixes use bytes rather than character counts
the independent wire bound wins when it is smaller
cached input is excluded from work but retained in uncached-context reservations

scope: Pure input reservation and accounting invariants. This is not the native transport/admission verification.
